# ContextOS

> Shared business limits for AI agents. ContextOS is a Rust runtime that governs what agents may do: it compiles Context Packs (policy, tools, decisions, evidence) into bounded context, enforces authorization, approvals and shared resource limits before a tool acts, and records signed, hash-chained evidence of every effect. Agents keep their own framework; consequential tools sit behind the ContextOS gateway (`contextosd`, HTTP), with an offline CLI (`ctx`) and Python, Node and in-process bindings. Status: alpha.

Key facts for agents working with this repository or a ContextOS deployment:

- A Context Pack (`context-pack.v2`) is the governed contract for one tenant. Policy rules are JsonLogic; no applying rule means deny; the highest-priority applying rules decide. A pack reference (`pack_id@pack_version`) names one content forever: its digest is bound in the store at first load, and a later load with other content is refused.
- Check a pack change offline with `ctx validate`, `ctx inspect`, `ctx test`, `ctx plan` and `ctx gate` before it ships; `ctx repl` tries one interactively.
- Every governed tool call goes through dispatch; `POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/tool-calls/check` answers what dispatch would do without effect.
- The audit chain is signed (Ed25519) and hash-chained per tenant; `ctx audit-verify` checks an export offline, and `ctx evidence-pack` turns one into a review folder for SOC 2, ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act or the OWASP agentic list.

## Docs

- [Guide](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md): deploying and operating the runtime, every API area, pack testing, plans, rule libraries, rollouts, audit sinks
- [Glossary](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/GLOSSARY.md): the terms runs, packs, effects and decisions use
- [Scope](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/SCOPE.md): what ContextOS does not govern
- [Shared business guarantees](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/SHARED_GUARANTEES.md): conserved limits across independent runs and replicas
- [Why not a database transaction?](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/WHY_NOT_A_TRANSACTION.md): why effects on external systems need reservations and reconciliation
- [Compensation](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/COMPENSATION.md): sagas for confirmed effects
- [Incident response](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/INCIDENT.md): kill switch, revocations, recovery
- [Threat model](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/security/THREAT_MODEL.md): threats and the tests that cover each

- [OpenAPI 3.1 for contextosd](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/openapi/contextosd.v1.json): every route with its scope (`x-contextos-scope`)

- [Run context schema](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/schemas/run-context.v1.schema.json)
- [Agent invocation schema](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/schemas/invoke-agent.v1.schema.json)

## Examples

- [Support refund quickstart](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/examples/support-refund/README.md): a pack, its tests, a pack built from a rule library, and a governed refund end to end
- [Shared guarantees](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/tree/main/examples/shared-guarantees): two agents against one shared ceiling
- [Replay](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/examples/replay/README.md): recorded tool-call traffic replayed through a gateway, with a report of what it would have refused, held or sent for approval
- [Consequential tools](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/examples/consequential-tools/README.md): a staging gateway with the starter guards refusing a production refund, a repeat from another run and spend past a daily cap, on replayed traffic
- [Deployment recipes](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/deploy/README.md): Helm, pack publishing from git, audit sinks
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/CONFIG.md): every contextosd key, generated from the code
- [Metric reference](https://github.com/contextosai/ContextOS/blob/main/docs/METRICS.md): every metric `/metrics` exports
